# SourceForge

> > SourceForge is a leading open-source software distribution platform hosting thousands of projects including popular tools like Notepad++, VLC media player, 7-Zip, Apache OpenOffice, FileZilla, and MinGW.

SourceForge provides hosting, distribution, and project management services for open-source software developers worldwide. The platform features project rankings, download statistics, and file browsing capabilities for discovering and accessing popular software applications across multiple categories.

## Key Topics

- Open-source software hosting
- Project rankings and statistics
- Popular downloads
- Notepad++
- VLC media player
- 7-Zip
- Apache OpenOffice
- FileZilla
- MinGW
- PortableApps.com
- Desktop applications
- File management tools
- Media players
- Development tools

## Project Discovery

- [Top Project Listings](https://sourceforge.net/top): Rankings of most popular SourceForge projects and downloads
